subject.title: feat(ios): improve onboarding gateway connection flow

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this full multi-path iOS onboarding chooser after rebasing onto the merged onboarding refresh, or keep the current simpler flow and port only the secure Tailscale/auth-copy improvements?
rationale: The PR is a feature-level first-run UX/security change, overlaps a merged onboarding refresh, and intentionally changes the raw 100.x setup path, so automation should not choose the permanent product direction.

options.title: Port secure pieces onto current flow
options.body: Keep the merged branded onboarding experience and carry over the raw 100.x rejection, Tailscale Serve/MagicDNS copy, and password-missing recovery where they fit.

options.title: Adopt full chooser after rebase
options.body: Rebase the PR onto current main, convert it to OpenClawType typography, and preserve proof for the complete chooser experience.

options.title: Pause or close the direction
options.body: Leave current main's onboarding as the supported product path and ask for a smaller follow-up if only one behavior needs to change.

recommendation.title: Port secure pieces onto current flow
recommendation.body: Keep the merged branded onboarding experience and carry over the raw 100.x rejection, Tailscale Serve/MagicDNS copy, and password-missing recovery where they fit.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the merged onboarding refresh that this PR now overlaps and are the closest current-main history signal for the first-run iOS UX choice.
